assumptions: ASSUMPTION_HYPOTHESIS_SPACE: Hypothesis space H is enumerable and covers the true underlying cause/mechanism (no ground truth outside H).
ASSUMPTION_PROBE_ADMISSIBILITY: Admissible probe set A is enumerable with known costs and observable outcomes (not latent actions).
ASSUMPTION_POSTERIOR_COMPUTABLE: Posterior πt(h) is computable from evidence Dt (not intractable).
ASSUMPTION_DECISION_RISK_DEFINED: Loss function L(d,h) for decision d under hypothesis h is defined and computable (not undefined).
ASSUMPTION_PROBE_OUTCOME_MODEL: Conditional outcome distribution P(y|a,h) is known or estimable for probe a under hypothesis h (not arbitrary).
ASSUMPTION_BUDGET_CONSTRAINED: Total probe cost budget K is known and enforced (not infinite).
ASSUMPTION_ABSTENTION_ALLOWED: Abstention (no decision or deferred decision) is permitted when confidence/entropy threshold not met (not forced decision).
ASSUMPTION_LEAKAGE_FREE: Evidence acquisition uses only raw telemetry (no label leakage to symptoms).
falsifier: Primary falsifier: random probe selection (no VOI optimization) achieves equal decision risk reduction (ΔR = R(πt) - Ey[R(πt+1)]) at lower computational cost than VOI-optimized sequential selection. Secondary falsifiers: (1) Fixed budget battery achieves equal risk reduction with simpler scheduling; (2) Bayesian posterior with unjustified prior causes misranking; (3) Probe outcome model misspecification causes VOI to select wrong probes; (4) Hypothesis space incomplete (true cause not in H) causes zero VOI and abstention when diagnostic opportunity exists; (5) Leakage present (label access) inflates VOI; (6) Forced decision without abstention causes high error; (7) CANNOT_CHECK opaque (no coordinate/action identification) fails to guide repair.
hard_gate_obligations: OBLIGATION_LEAKAGE_FREE: Evidence acquisition must use raw telemetry only (no label access to symptoms).
OBLIGATION_VOI_POSITIVE: Probe selected only if VOI(a) > 0 (positive expected risk reduction).
OBLIGATION_POSTERIOR_COMPUTABLE: Posterior πt(h) must be computable from evidence Dt (not undefined).
OBLIGATION_BUDGET_ENFORCED: Total probe cost must not exceed budget K ( enforced).
OBLIGATION_ABSTENTION_ALLOWED: Abstention permitted when entropy > threshold or no positive VOI probe exists.
OBLIGATION_PROBE_COST_KNOWN: Probe cost c(a) must be known before selection (not arbitrary).
OBLIGATION_DECISION_RISK_DEFINED: Loss function L(d,h) must be defined for all decision-hypothesis pairs.
OBLIGATION_HYPOTHESIS_COMPLETE: Hypothesis space H must be enumerable (not infinite/unbounded).
OBLIGATION_CANNOTH_CHECK_EXPLICIT: CANNOT_CHECK must identify missing coordinate and admissible acquisition actions (not opaque).
minimal_counterexamples: COUNTEREXAMPLE_RANDOM_DOMINATES: Random probe selection (no VOI) achieves equal decision risk reduction at lower computational cost than VOI-optimized selection.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_FIXED_BUDGET_DOMINATES: Fixed budget battery (all probes at fixed budget K) achieves equal risk reduction with simpler scheduling than sequential VOI.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_POSTERIOR_UNJUSTIFIED: Bayesian posterior πt(h) relies on unjustified prior (prior bias dominates evidence), causing VOI to misrank probes.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_PROBE_OUTCOME_MODEL_WRONG: Conditional outcome model P(y|a,h) is misspecified, causing expected posterior risk Ey[R(πt+1)] to be inaccurate and VOI to select wrong probes.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_HYPOTHESIS_SPACE_INCOMPLETE: True cause not in hypothesis space H, causing all probes to have zero VOI and AFD to abstain when diagnostic opportunity exists.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_LEAKAGE_PRESENT: Evidence acquisition uses label information (not raw telemetry only), violating leakage-free assumption and inflating VOI.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_ABSTENTION_FAILURE: AFD forces decision when entropy > threshold (no abstention allowed), causing high-error decisions.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_CANNOTHCHECK_OPAQUE: CANNOT_CHECK returned without identifying missing coordinate or admissible acquisition actions (opaque failure).
novelty_residual: Novelty claimed only for: (1) Generalization of #539 active sequential diagnosis beyond failure diagnosis to arbitrary open fibres (any hypothesis space with probes, not just mechanistic failure modes); (2) Integration of VOI-based probe selection with ordinal/set-valued variant for unjustified probability settings; (3) CANNOT_CHECK repair protocol that explicitly identifies missing load-bearing coordinates and admissible acquisition actions (not opaque failure). Delta over parents: #539 diagnosis is specialized to failure modes; classical VOI theory lacks ordinal/set-valued variant; active learning lacks CANNOT_CHECK repair protocol. Permitted publication claim must be scoped to these residuals after strongest-parent differential is measured.
object_description: Active Fibre Discriminator (AFD): generalize #539 active sequential diagnosis to every open fibre. For competing hypotheses H = {hi}, admissible probes A, posterior πt(h) = P(h|Dt), and decision risk R(π) = mind Eπ[L(d,h)], compute Value of Information for probe a: VOI(a) = R(πt) - Ey[R(πt+1)] - c(a). Choose probe a* = argmaxa∈A VOI(a) when positive. If probabilities are unjustified, use ordinal/set-valued variant maximizing worst-case elimination of live environments or load-bearing distinctions. Output: EvidenceAcquisitionProposal, never authority. CANNOT_CHECK repair must carry: missing load-bearing coordinate, admissible acquisition actions, expected cost, expiry, and reason no cheaper probe suffices.
oracle_or_lower_bound: Lower bound: random probe selection (no VOI optimization) achieves equal decision risk reduction at lower cost (no VOI computation overhead). Oracle: optimal probe sequence that maximizes cumulative VOI subject to budget K (known only when full outcome model is observable).
permitted_publication_claim: PERMITTED_CLAIM_SCOPE: M6_AFD_v0 achieves higher decision risk reduction than random probe selection at equal budget when VOI-optimized selection uses leakage-free evidence and abstains when no positive VOI exists. NO authority claimed for: (1) hypothesis spaces with unjustified priors; (2) probe outcome models that are misspecified; (3) settings where leakage is present; (4) cases where abstention is not allowed; (5) CANNOT_CHECK failures that don't identify missing coordinates. Claim scope is limited to leakage-free active sequential diagnosis with justified posteriors and explicit CANNOT_CHECK repair.
qoi: Active fibre discrimination quality measured by: (1) Decision risk reduction: ΔR = R(πt) - Ey[R(πt+1)] achieved by selected probe; (2) VOI efficiency: VOI(a) / c(a) ratio (information per unit cost); (3) Hypothesis posterior concentration: entropy reduction or elimination rate; (4) Load-bearing distinction resolution: fraction of load-bearing distinctions resolved; (5) Sequential efficiency: total probes used vs fixed budget baseline; (6) Early stopping capability: correct abstention when no positive VOI probe exists.
same_system_ablation: Ablations required on same input data: (1) RANDOM: random probe selection without VOI optimization; (2) FIXED_BUDGET: all probes at fixed budget K, no sequential selection; (3) NO_ABSTENTION: force decision even when entropy > threshold; (4) LEAKAGE_INJECTION: allow label access in evidence acquisition; (5) UNIFORM_PRIOR: use uniform prior instead of informed prior; (6) NO_POSTERIOR_UPDATE: select probes without posterior update; (7) ORACLE_VOI: use oracle VOI (observable outcome model). Each ablation must run on identical development and fresh case sets to isolate specific mechanistic contributions.

strongest_parents.justification: #539 active sequential diagnosis successor provides leakage-free generative model, info-gain probe selection, and matched-budget comparison. Strongest in-repo parent for active sequential diagnosis.
Classical Value of Information theory provides VOI(a) = R(πt) - Ey[R(πt+1)] - c(a) formula for optimal information acquisition. Strongest parent for probe selection.
Active learning query strategies provide uncertainty sampling and optimal experimental design for information acquisition. Strongest parent for probe selection under uncertainty.

total_cost_equation: total_cost = voi_computation_cost + probe_execution_cost + posterior_update_cost + decision_risk_cost + ablation_comparison_cost. VOI computation cost = sum over probes of (expected_posterior_summation_cost + risk_reduction_calculation_cost + cost_subtraction_cost). Probe execution cost = sum over selected probes of c(a). Posterior update cost = sum over updates of (bayes_update_cost + entropy_calculation_cost). Decision risk cost = sum over risk calculations of (loss_evaluation_cost + expectation_cost). Ablation comparison cost = sum over ablations of same_system_run_cost.
